summary: Neversoft and Activision's Western action-adventure, including the expanded PSP Gun: Showdown release.

entries.title: Gun
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version for main play; PSP Gun: Showdown for added content

emulation.emulator: Native Windows and PPSSPP for PSP additions
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; use PPSSPP or PSP hardware for Showdown additions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC main game, with PSP-exclusive content as secondary

primary.why: Gun released for Windows, PlayStation 2, Xbox, GameCube, Xbox 360, and PSP. Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the main game, while PSP's Gun: Showdown adds new side missions, multiplayer, and other additions worth a secondary check.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively with compatibility fixes if needed; then sample Gun: Showdown on PSP/PPSSPP for its added side missions and multiplayer content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Gun: Showdown additions including new side missions, multiplayer mode, and throwing knives
secondary.what_to_play: Play or sample the PSP-exclusive side missions and multiplayer additions after the Windows main run.
secondary.why: Gun: Showdown adds content not available in the console/PC versions.

all_releases.fidelity: Gun: Showdown handheld release with new side missions, multiplayer mode, and other additions.
all_releases.reason: secondary: PSP-exclusive added content, but lower fidelity than Windows.
skip: strong console route but no content advantage over Windows; PSP has the unique additions.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with Live Aware support.
all_releases.reason: skip: original route but lower practical fidelity than Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the fidelity main route; PSP Gun: Showdown has exclusive side missions/multiplayer additions and should be sampled second.
